ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobes; thick black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips. Distinct cluster of ~12 black circular spots in the upper right quadrant of the right lobe. Black pigmentation extends from the peduncle in a defined V-shape.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated pixel angle of 62 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge from tips to notch; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-18 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, high-contrast points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of circular, high-contrast light-colored bumps (barnacles) at both distal tips; scattered individual barnacles visible across the white surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, nearly vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the distal tips and trailing edges; several vertical linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-brown tonal variation (bio-staining) localized in the lower quadrant of the left lobe near the peduncle transition.
